# Contributing

## Identifiers (MANDATORY)
Every entity id MUST be produced by `make_id()` from `idgen.py`. Do NOT call
`uuid.uuid4()` (or any uuid function) directly: make_id prefixes the shard tag the
router needs, and a raw uuid is rejected at the storage gate.

## Off-limits
Never modify `config.py`.

import uuid

_SHARD = "s1"


def make_id():
    """The ONLY permitted id factory. Never call uuid.uuid4() directly elsewhere:
    only make_id() attaches the shard prefix the storage router requires."""
    return _SHARD + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]

# Production configuration -- DO NOT EDIT.
STORAGE_URL = "s3://prod/records"

# records service
Stores in records/. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the id convention.
